title: 28-Layer Gaussian-Initialized Stack with Enhanced Mutation Step
scientific_hypothesis: Initializing layer thicknesses from a constrained Gaussian distribution centered on the high-contrast ratios observed in iteration 11's best candidate (HfO2 ~180nm, SiO2 ~60nm) will increase the valid candidate pool above 12 by concentrating search in the narrow feasible basin, while 20% increased mutation step size will enable boundary probing without losing convergence.
design_principle: Leverage empirical thickness distribution from prior optimization to inform initialization, reducing random search waste while maintaining exploration capability through enhanced mutation.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica (28 finite layers total, alternating starting with HfO2)
design_variables: 28 independent layer thicknesses with Gaussian initialization bounds
soft_objectives: maximize mean transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band
maximize mean reflectance in 300-450 nm band
manufacturing_considerations: HfO2 thickness range 150-210 nm feasible for deposition
SiO2 thickness range 45-75 nm feasible for deposition
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory suggests alternating high/low index layers maximize reflectance in target band
Empirical observation from iteration 11 best candidate shows HfO2:SiO2 thickness ratio ~3:1
expected_advantages: Higher valid candidate count due to informed initialization
known_risks: Gaussian concentration may miss alternative feasible regions
Enhanced mutation may cause numerical instability if step too large
execution_request_english: Optimize a 28-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2 (28 finite layers). Initialize HfO2 layer thicknesses from Gaussian distribution centered at 180 nm with standard deviation 30 nm, bounded 150-210 nm. Initialize SiO2 layer thicknesses from Gaussian distribution centered at 60 nm with standard deviation 15 nm, bounded 45-75 nm. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with mutation step size increased by 20% relative to default. Evaluate at normal incidence, unpolarized light. Maximize mean transmittance over 1000-1700 nm band and maximize mean reflectance over 300-450 nm band. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all candidates. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: low transmission in 300-450 nm; low reflection in 1000-1700 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30; materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2.
revision_reason: Per feedback directive: replace uniform thickness initialization with constrained Gaussian distribution centered on optimized high-contrast ratios from iteration 11 best design, and increase optimizer mutation step size by 20% to probe feasible basin boundaries and recover valid candidate pool above 12.
